title: 第1506章 酒过三巡玩游戏第1505章 入三层双圣震惊
content_zh:
“剑出如永夜降临，剑过如寒星掠空。”
“普通宝器分普通、精品、珍品、极品四等，能入极品之列者，无一不是同阶中的佼佼者。”
老者收回手，神色肃然：“此剑的标价，是两亿灵晶。”
两亿。
林玄眼中闪过一丝波动。
金戈战矛估价一亿两千万，尚差八千万。
他翻手取出四千万灵石灵晶，堆放在展台上。
灵晶散发着柔和的荧光，将整片区域都映照得通亮。
“金戈战矛加四千万灵晶，换这柄永夜圣青冥剑。”
林玄的声音平静如水。
黑衣老者目光在金戈战矛和灵晶间扫过，沉默片刻后，缓缓点头。
“可以。”
他取出一枚黑色令牌，在灵光罩上轻轻一划。
灵光罩如水流般消散，永夜圣青冥剑彻底暴露在空气中。
那一刻——
一股恐怖的黑暗圣气从剑身上轰然爆发！
整座三层大厅的灵光都在这一刻黯淡了几分，仿佛真的有永夜降临。
漆黑如墨的剑芒从剑身上疯狂涌出，朝四面八方肆虐而去。
林玄伸手握住了剑柄。
就在他的手指触碰到剑柄的瞬间，丹田中的九劫剑猛地一震，一股浩瀚的剑意从林玄体内爆发而出。

那股剑意与永夜圣青冥剑的黑暗圣气激烈碰撞，却又在碰撞中迅速交融。
永夜圣青冥剑发出一声低沉的剑鸣，那鸣声仿佛来自深渊的召唤，带着一种古老而神秘的韵律。
剑身上的黑暗圣气不再是疯狂肆虐，而是开始顺着林玄的手臂涌入他的体内。
那股黑暗圣气所过之处，林玄只觉经脉中传来一阵刺骨的冰寒，但这冰寒却并未伤及经脉分毫，反而与他的灵力产生了某种奇异的共鸣。
他闭上眼睛，感受着剑中蕴含的力量。
永夜，深渊，寒星，杀戮。
种种意境在他心中流转，与他修炼的青冥剑法不断地契合、交融。
林玄情不自禁地挥出一剑。
一道漆黑的剑芒从剑身上激射而出。
那剑芒漆黑如墨，快若惊鸿，仿佛永夜中唯一闪过的寒光。
剑芒掠过大厅，直直朝着一名正在挑选宝器的九霄圣君斩去。
那九霄圣君面色剧变，双臂猛然交叉，一层青色的圣元光罩瞬间撑起。
然而——
剑芒斩在光罩上，青色光罩剧烈震荡，表面浮现出道道裂纹。
下一瞬，光罩轰然碎裂，剑芒的余波将那九霄圣君整个人都震得倒飞出去，重重撞在身后的灵光罩上。
整座三层大厅都为之一静。
所有人的目光都聚焦到林玄身上。
林玄也回过神来，眉头微皱。
他刚才只是顺着那股剑意挥出一剑，并未动用什么灵力，没想到威力竟如此惊人。
那被击飞的九霄圣君踉跄着站稳身形，脸色苍白如纸，胸口处的衣袍已被剑意撕裂，露出一道浅浅的血痕。

他的眼中满是惊骇，却不敢发怒。
能一剑将他击飞的，绝非寻常人物。
林玄收起永夜圣青冥剑，朝那九霄圣君走去。
“一时失手，多有得罪。”他翻手取出两壶酒，递了过去，“左壶岩浆酒，右壶冰海酒，算是在下的一点赔礼。”
content_en:
"The sword comes out like eternal night falling, and the sword passes like cold stars in the sky."
"Ordinary treasures are divided into four categories: ordinary, fine, rare, and top quality. Those who can be ranked among the top quality are all the best in the same class."
The old man retracted his hand and said solemnly: "The price of this sword is 200 million spiritual crystals."
Two hundred million.
A flash of fluctuation flashed in Lin Xuan's eyes.
The Golden Ge War Spear is estimated at 120 million, which is still 80 million short.
He turned over his hands and took out 40 million spiritual stones and crystals and piled them on the booth.
The spiritual crystal emits soft fluorescence, illuminating the entire area brightly.
"The Golden Ge War Spear plus 40 million spiritual crystals are exchanged for this Eternal Night Holy Green Underworld Sword."
Lin Xuan's voice was as calm as water.
The old man in black glanced between the golden spear and the spiritual crystal. After a moment of silence, he nodded slowly.
"Okay."
He took out a black token and lightly drew it on the spiritual light shield.
The spiritual light shield dissipated like water, and the Eternal Night Holy Green Underworld Sword was completely exposed to the air.
That moment——
A terrifying dark holy energy burst out from the sword!
The aura of the entire three-story hall dimmed a bit at this moment, as if eternal night had really fallen.
The jet-black sword light surged wildly from the sword body, raging in all directions.
Lin Xuan reached out and grasped the hilt of the sword.
The moment his finger touched the hilt of the sword, the Nine Tribulations Sword in his dantian shook violently, and a vast sword intent burst out from Lin Xuan's body.
The sword intent collided fiercely with the dark holy energy of the Evernight Holy Green Underworld Sword, but they quickly merged during the collision.
The Eternal Night Holy Green Underworld Sword made a low sword sound. The sound seemed like a call from the abyss, carrying an ancient and mysterious rhythm.
The dark holy energy on the sword no longer raged wildly, but began to pour into Lin Xuan's body along his arm.
Wherever the dark holy energy passed, Lin Xuan felt a biting coldness in his meridians. However, this coldness did not hurt the meridians at all. Instead, it had some strange resonance with his spiritual power.
He closed his eyes and felt the power contained in the sword.
Eternal night, abyss, cold stars, killing.
All kinds of artistic conceptions circulated in his heart, constantly fitting and blending with the Qingming Sword Technique he practiced.
Lin Xuanqing couldn't help but swing a sword.
A jet-black sword light shot out from the sword.
The sword light was as black as ink and as fast as a thunderbolt, as if it were the only cold light flashing in the eternal night.
The sword light swept across the hall, heading straight towards a Nine Heavens Saint Lord who was selecting a treasure.
The Jiuxiao Saint Lord's expression changed drastically, his arms suddenly crossed, and a layer of cyan Saint Yuan light shield instantly propped up.
However——
The sword light struck the light shield, and the cyan light shield vibrated violently, with cracks appearing on the surface.
The next moment, the light shield suddenly shattered, and the aftermath of the sword light sent the Nine Heavens Holy Lord flying backwards, hitting the spiritual light shield behind him heavily.
The entire three-story hall fell into silence.
All eyes were focused on Lin Xuan.
Lin Xuan also came to his senses and frowned slightly.
He just swung the sword in accordance with the sword intention without using any spiritual power. He didn't expect the power to be so amazing.
The Nine Heavens Saint Lord who was knocked away staggered to his feet, his face was as pale as paper, and the robe on his chest had been torn apart by the sword, revealing a shallow trace of blood.
His eyes were full of horror, but he didn't dare to get angry.
Someone who can knock him away with a single sword is by no means an ordinary person.
Lin Xuan put away the Evernight Holy Green Underworld Sword and walked towards the Nine Heavens Holy Lord.
"If you miss, you will be offended." He turned over his hand and took out two bottles of wine and handed them over, "The left bottle is lava wine, and the right bottle is ice sea wine. This is a little apology."
